author: Antonialock
body:
this entry no longer has the annotation from ARBA but it does have it from unipathway (so this should be removed witht he sunsetting of that pipeline). 

pombe can use glycerol as a carbon source in presence of ethanol (ethanol helps derepress the genes required e.g:
S. pombe requires a small amount of ethanol or 1-propanol in order to assimilate glycerol. Expression of gld1 + increased slightly by shifting cells grown on glucose to glycerol medium that may be associated with glucose derepression. We suggest that this derepression of gld1 + is insufficient to permit growth of S. pombe on glycerol and that induction of gld1 + and fbp1 + by ethanol or 1-propanol is also required. This is consistent with glycerol assimilation in S. pombe being regulated by two different mechanisms, glucose-repression and ethanol/1-propanol induction. It is intriguing that low concentrations of ethanol or 1-propanol induce a metabolic change in S. pombe allowing glycerol assimilation. In nature, S. pombe presumably assimilates favorable carbon sources such as glucose, fructose, and sucrose preferentially to produce ethanol by fermentation. Thereafter, it appears that S. pombe may also be able to assimilate glycerol in the presence of the produced ethanol due to induction of gld1 + and fbp1 +.
https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00253-012-3971-x#Sec14
